Subject: Workspace seat pooling, laptop staging & expedited shipping plan

Hi all,

We need to lock down logistics for the new Dublin node and a short-term coworking seat pool while we finalize the leased space. High level ask below — looking for quotes and lead times by EOD Tue Nov 3.

Scope: 1) Staging & imaging for 120 MacBook Air-equivalent units (imaging, asset tag, shrinkwrap, palletization)
2) Air freight (Dublin airport delivery) for an initial 40 units on an expedited 48–72h SLA, then weekly shipments of 20 units for 4 weeks
3) Short-term coworking seat pool for 25 flexible seats (start date Nov 15) with member credits and meeting-room allocation

Please include: pricing breakdown, customs handling (ETA Dublin), damage liability, insurance options, any minimums, and T&Cs. Attach a staging manifest template and a sample quote if you can.

Internal: Dev/Laura — confirm budget band and whether we can push for air, and Grace/Vivek, any constraints on inventory/serialing standards?

Attachments: staging_manifest_template.csv

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Head of Workplace & Procurement
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Workspace seat pooling, laptop staging & expedited shipping plan

Hi Priyom — thanks for the clear brief. See our high-level reply below; full line-item PDF attached (quote_ATLAS_2143.pdf).

Summary (EMEA expedited program):
- Imaging & tagging (per unit): €18 (image, Apple DEP enrollment prep, asset tag, basic QA)
- Palletization & crating (per shipment): €220
- Air freight (DUB door-to-door, 48–72h for first 40 units): €1,450 per shipment (customs broker included)
- Weekly shipments (20 units): €800 per shipment via consolidated air solution
- Insurance: 1.2% of goods value (recommended)
- Customs clearance: we handle EORI/decls; duties negligible for corporate equipment, VAT handling as per contract

Lead times: we can begin staging at our London facility on Nov 6, first flight out Nov 9 for Nov 10 delivery (if approved by Nov 4 COB).

Notes/risks: prioritizing space on next outbound flights is contingent on confirmed PO and advance payment for first expedited shipment. Attachment includes pallet dimensions and a suggested manifest layout.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Account Manager — Atlas Logistics
ops@atlaslogistics.com
Attachment: quote_ATLAS_2143.pdf

- 25 flexible seats starting Nov 15, billed monthly in arrears; interchangeable across three Dublin sites
